verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God, the LORD, has spoken, And summoned the earth from the rising of the sun to its setting.
verses.textZh: （亞薩的詩。）大能者神─耶和華已經發言招呼天下，從日出之地到日落之處。

verses.text: Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God has shone forth.
verses.textZh: 從全美的錫安中，神已經發光了。

verses.text: May our God come and not keep silence; Fire devours before Him, And it is very tempestuous around Him.
verses.textZh: 我們的神要來，決不閉口。有烈火在他面前吞滅；有暴風在他四圍大颳。

verses.text: He summons the heavens above, And the earth, to judge His people:
verses.textZh: 他招呼上天下地，為要審判他的民，

verses.text: 'Gather My godly ones to Me, Those who have made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.'
verses.textZh: 說：招聚我的聖民到我這裡來，就是那些用祭物與我立約的人。

verses.text: And the heavens declare His righteousness, For God Himself is judge. Selah.
verses.textZh: 諸天必表明他的公義，因為神是施行審判的。（細拉）

verses.text: 'Hear, O My people, and I will speak; O Israel, I will testify against you; I am God, your God.
verses.textZh: 我的民哪，你們當聽我的話！以色列啊，我要勸戒你；我是神，是你的　神！

verses.text: 'I do not reprove you for your sacrifices, And your burnt offerings are continually before Me.
verses.textZh: 我並不因你的祭物責備你；你的燔祭常在我面前。

verses.text: 'I shall take no young bull out of your house Nor male goats out of your folds.
verses.textZh: 我不從你家中取公牛，也不從你圈內取山羊；

verses.text: 'For every beast of the forest is Mine, The cattle on a thousand hills.
verses.textZh: 因為，樹林中的百獸是我的，千山上的牲畜也是我的。

verses.text: 'I know every bird of the mountains, And everything that moves in the field is Mine.
verses.textZh: 山中的飛鳥，我都知道；野地的走獸也都屬我。

verses.text: 'If I were hungry I would not tell you, For the world is Mine, and all it contains.
verses.textZh: 我若是飢餓，我不用告訴你，因為世界和其中所充滿的都是我的。

verses.text: 'Shall I eat the flesh of bulls Or drink the blood of male goats?
verses.textZh: 我豈吃公牛的肉呢？我豈喝山羊的血呢？

verses.text: 'Offer to God a sacrifice of thanksgiving And pay your vows to the Most High;
verses.textZh: 你們要以感謝為祭獻與神，又要向至高者還你的願，

verses.text: Call upon Me in the day of trouble; I shall rescue you, and you will honor Me.'
verses.textZh: 並要在患難之日求告我；我必搭救你，你也要榮耀我。

verses.text: But to the wicked God says, 'What right have you to tell of My statutes And to take My covenant in your mouth?
verses.textZh: 但神對惡人說：你怎敢傳說我的律例，口中提到我的約呢？

verses.text: 'For you hate discipline, And you cast My words behind you.
verses.textZh: 其實你恨惡管教，將我的言語丟在背後。

verses.text: 'When you see a thief, you are pleased with him, And you associate with adulterers.
verses.textZh: 你見了盜賊就樂意與他同夥，又與行姦淫的人一同有分。

verses.text: 'You let your mouth loose in evil And your tongue frames deceit.
verses.textZh: 你口任說惡言；你舌編造詭詐。

verses.text: 'You sit and speak against your brother; You slander your own mother's son.
verses.textZh: 你坐著毀謗你的兄弟，讒毀你親母的兒子。

verses.text: 'These things you have done and I kept silence; You thought that I was just like you; I will reprove you and state [the case] in order before your eyes.
verses.textZh: 你行了這些事，我還閉口不言，你想我恰和你一樣；其實我要責備你，將這些事擺在你眼前。

verses.text: 'Now consider this, you who forget God, Or I will tear [you] in pieces, and there will be none to deliver.
verses.textZh: 你們忘記神的，要思想這事，免得我把你們撕碎，無人搭救。

verses.text: 'He who offers a sacrifice of thanksgiving honors Me; And to him who orders [his] way [aright] I shall show the salvation of God.'
verses.textZh: 凡以感謝獻上為祭的便是榮耀我；那按正路而行的，我必使他得著我的救恩。
